academicYears.title: Academic years
academicYears.intro: The school's academic years: the one being prepared, the one under way and those already closed.
academicYears.caption: Academic years of the school

empty.title: There are no academic years yet
empty.text: Create the first academic year to get started.

form.codeHint: Free text, unique in the school, for example 2026-2027.

notEditable.title: This academic year can no longer be edited
notEditable.text: An academic year can only be edited while it is in planning.

form.planningExists: There is already an academic year in planning: {code}.
form.openPlanning: Open the academic year in planning ({code})

detail.title: Academic year
detail.readOnly: Academic year {status}: its data is read-only.
detail.closureTitle: The academic year cannot be closed yet:
detail.noActions: This academic year admits no further actions.
detail.reopenTitle: The academic year cannot be reopened yet:

activate.title: Activate academic year {code}
activate.description: The academic year will become the school's active academic year.
activate.descriptionEnded: The end date of this academic year has already passed. It will still become the school's active academic year.

close.title: Close academic year {code}
close.description: Closing blocks writing: from now on the data of this academic year is read-only in all modules of the school. It can only be undone while no other academic year has been activated, by someone with the reopening permission and recording the reason; once the next academic year is activated, it can no longer be reopened.

errors.unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.

reopen.title: Reopen academic year {code}
reopen.description: Reopen an academic year that was closed by mistake. It will become the school's active academic year again.
reopen.warningWritable: All the data of the academic year will accept writing again in all modules.
reopen.warningNotCorrection: Reopening is not meant to correct a specific piece of data: it reopens the whole academic year.
reopen.warningReason: The reason is recorded. Do not include personal data in the reason.

rollover.reopenWarning: This academic year is the source of a completed structure copy into academic year “{target}”, which is still in planning. Reopening it does not affect that copy, but what was copied may fall out of date with the changes you make now.

section.title: Structure copy
section.loadFailed: The structure copy could not be loaded.
section.none: This academic year has no structure copy yet.
section.copy: Copy structure from another academic year

failure.target_not_planning: The target year is no longer in planning
failure.target_changed: Data changed during the copy; try again
failure.actor_unavailable: The person who requested it no longer has an active account; nothing was done

wizard.title: Copy the structure of another academic year into {target}
wizard.intro: Choose which academic year to copy from and what to copy. You will see a simulation before anything runs. What is copied can be reviewed and corrected in each module’s screens.
wizard.noSources: There is no active or closed academic year before this one to copy from.
wizard.elementsHelp: Tick what you want to copy. What you leave unticked will be created from scratch by hand. Ticking an item also ticks the ones it needs.
wizard.noElements: No subscribed module offers items to copy.

blocked.forbidden: You do not have permission to create this item.
blocked.requiresForbidden: You do not have permission to create one of the items it needs.

teachingAssignments.label: Copy teaching assignments
teachingAssignments.help: Copies the teachers of each subject and group and the group tutors; if you also copy the timetable frames, the timetable sessions too. People who are no longer active at the school are left out. Review what was copied afterwards.
teachingAssignments.forbidden: You do not have permission to create teaching assignments, group tutors or timetable sessions.

wizard.blockingTitle: The copy cannot be run yet:
wizard.notExecutable: It cannot be confirmed while there are issues.

confirmDialog.title: Copy the structure from {source} to {target}
confirmDialog.description: The chosen items will be copied into academic year {target}. The source academic year is not modified.
confirmDialog.background: The copy runs in the background; it may take a few minutes.
confirmDialog.revertible: It can be reverted while academic year {target} is still in planning.
confirmDialog.revertLoses: Reverting also discards any changes made to what was copied.

notPlanning.title: This academic year cannot receive a copy
notPlanning.text: The structure can only be copied into an academic year that is in planning.

detail.title: Structure copy
detail.inProgress: The copy is being processed in the background.
detail.stalled: The copy is still queued; check again later.
detail.revertFailureTitle: The last revert could not be completed

revertConfirm.title: Revert the copy in {target}
revertConfirm.description: What this copy created will be deleted, even if it was edited afterwards: changes made to what was copied are lost. The source academic year is not modified.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel the copy
cancelConfirm.description: The copy will be marked as failed; nothing was copied.
